images.name: ai-chat
images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one square editorial collage illustration for a conference presentation, part of a cohesive set of four. Style: sophisticated cut-paper editorial photomontage in the style of a contemporary independent technology magazine; physical paper scraps, grayscale photographic cutouts with cream cut edges, sparse halftone dots, subtle newsprint grain, understated contact shadows. Warm ivory paper background #EFEAE0, near-black #151412, muted teal #A3CFCB cut-paper backing field, small vermilion red #E5432F and yellow #FFE234 accents, occasional navy #173E5F. Flat frontal composition with a single strong metaphor, large recognizable forms that work at thumbnail size. Square 1:1 frame, centered subject within generous 12% safe margins, consistent scale across the set. NOT a slide: a single illustration, no border, no captions, NO LETTERS, NO WORDS, NO NUMERALS, no logos, no watermark. No glossy 3D, no cartoons, no neon, no gradients, no robot faces or humanoid robots. Subject: AI CHAT. A grayscale photographic cutout of a simple retro desktop computer displaying two oversized blank speech balloons, one ivory and one red, suggesting a human asking a question and an AI answering. A small cutout human hand on the keyboard; the exchange is the entire concept. A muted teal paper circle behind the monitor and a sparse patch of black halftone. Large speech balloons have no text or symbols. Keep the computer simple and iconic, clearly a conversation rather than a code editor.
